## Your weekly perfume digest
**October 11–17, 2026 · Autumn**

No owned perfumes were returned in any of the seven candidate pools, so I can’t make evidence-based picks this week. This doesn’t necessarily mean your collection is empty—only that no candidates were available.

| Category | This week’s direction | Picks |
|---|---|---|
| **ForgottenFavorite** | Revisit well-rated scents that have slipped out of rotation. | None available; no qualifying favorites were returned. |
| **SimilarToLastUsed** | Follow the character of your latest wear. | None available; no recent wears or candidates were supplied. |
| **Seasonal** | Explore scents suited to autumn’s cooler days. | None available; no owned candidates were returned. |
| **Random** | Make an adventurous detour from your usual rotation. | None available; no owned candidates were returned. |
| **LeastUsed** | Give overlooked bottles some attention. | None available; no candidates with usage evidence were returned. |
| **LongestTimeAgo** | Reconnect with scents you haven’t worn in a while. | None available; no candidates with wear-history evidence were returned. |
| **MoodOrOccasion** | **A quiet autumn reading afternoon**—a relaxed occasion for this week. | None available; no owned candidates were returned. |

All seven categories are short of the five requested picks. Once collection candidates are available, I can build the digest without inventing bottles, ratings, or wear history.
